gloss: hazard management; danger management; safety management

definitions.gloss: hazard management; danger management; safety management
definitions.explanation: The systematic identification and control of dangers and hazards, particularly in workplaces, industrial settings, and daily life. Focuses on preventing accidents and injuries.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧ (danger; hazard) and ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management; control). Distinguished from ⟦{危機|きき}{管理|かんり}→危機管理：25685_kikikanri⟧ (crisis management, reactive) and ⟦リスク{管理|かんり}→リスク管理：26519_risukukanri⟧ (risk management, probabilistic), {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり} emphasizes proactive identification and prevention of concrete dangers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: hazard management system
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: safety awareness
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧: hazard management manual
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: safety management training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{危機|きき}{管理|かんり}→危機管理：25685_kikikanri⟧: crisis management — dealing with crises after they occur
- ⟦リスク{管理|かんり}→リスク管理：26519_risukukanri⟧: risk management — assessing and mitigating probabilistic risks
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}→安全管理：23551_anzenkanri⟧: safety management — broader term for ensuring safety in general
